description: Albania's water regulator ERRU produced an annual Performance Report that reviews the operational, financial and customer service performance of each water supply and sewerage operator against key performance indicators, used to set tariff targets and let operators compare themselves. Coverage is Albania by operator, and each report sets results in the context of the operators' real conditions. The reports are free to read and download from the ERRU site. Caveats: the data are supplied by the operators themselves, and ERRU notes that its quantitative analysis may not always give the full picture. Simulation uses: operator indicators for service performance baselines and capacity planning. Related records: the Czech water utility benchmarking (data-czech-mze-water-utility-benchmarking-vak).
